description: Full-width responsive container web part supporting tabs, accordions, and custom cards/embeds for SharePoint Online.
architecture: SPFx v1.23+ Heft Toolchain with React 17 and Microsoft Fluent UI 2 (@fluentui/react-components)

modules.name: FullWidthContainerWebPart
modules.role: Entrypoint SPFx WebPart class managing lifecycle, theme variants, property pane, and rendering React root.

modules.name: ThemeBridge
modules.role: Bridges SharePoint SPFx IReadonlyTheme / semanticColors to Fluent UI 2 Theme tokens for FluentProvider.

modules.name: FullWidthContainer
modules.role: Root React container component wrapping hierarchy in FluentProvider, handling layout switching, filtering, and search.

modules.name: TabsContainer
modules.role: Fluent 2 TabList and Tab navigation view with active indicators and responsive card grid.

modules.name: AccordionContainer
modules.role: Fluent 2 Accordion, AccordionItem, and AccordionHeader collapsible layout with Expand/Collapse All toolbar.

modules.name: BlockRenderer
modules.role: Renders child content items using Fluent 2 Card, Badge, Button, and Key Metrics in GBP £.

modules.name: CardEditDialog
modules.role: In-place Fluent UI 2 Modal Dialog for editing card type, icon, badge, links, and British financial metrics on canvas.

modules.name: FloatingTextToolbar
modules.role: Floating contextual formatting ribbon modeled after the native SharePoint Text Web Part toolbar.

modules.name: ContainerModels
modules.role: Type definitions for panels, tabs, items, layout configuration, and default UK datasets.
